fact.en: Thinking the King had absolute power: The King still faced constraints from the Sabha and Samiti.

fact.en: Confusing 'Janapada' with 'Mahajanapada': Janapadas emerged in Later Vedic, Mahajanapadas followed in the 6th century BCE.

fact.en: Assuming taxation was institutionalized: Taxes (Bali) were still more of a voluntary offering or tribute than a fixed state revenue system.
